exposure: mortality in normal weight babies index
cohort: The study included all newborns who received care at Special Newborn Care Units (SNCUs) of 10 aspirational districts in Odisha.
finding: The overall composite SQCI score for the 10 SNCUs demonstrated satisfactory performance (0.56-0.68) during 2020-2022, although the Low Birth Weight Admission Index was unsatisfactory (0.22-0.30) and perinatal asphyxia was a significant cause of morbidity.
birth_weight: All newborns were included, with specific performance indicators analyzed for normal weight and low birth weight babies.
